card.text: Explore Adrastea through a model based on its measured dimensions.

introduction.text: Adrastea is a tiny moon near the outer edge of Jupiter’s main ring. Galileo barely resolved its outline; this view shows a model based on its measured dimensions.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Galileo-based shape estimate. No surface imagery is available; craters and terrain are unresolved.
